label: Inked adventure comic
styleBlock: Hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic: expressive variable-weight brush contours, simplified believable anatomy, bold silhouette design, flat opaque colors, two or three hard-edged shadow shapes, sparse dry-brush texture, and selective line detail at faces and focal materials. Mature, handmade, and readable; no painterly blending, no glossy 3D.

anchor.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept
Asset type: FC House Style consistency exploration anchor board
Primary request: Create one square 2x2 visual anchor board with four equal-sized panels separated by narrow, even gutters and no labels.
Subjects: top-left, one adult medieval woman warrior standing in a village courtyard; top-right, one adult brown bear standing in a forest clearing; bottom-left, one four-legged, two-winged dragon standing on a rocky upland; bottom-right, a small medieval village with houses, a central well, and a watchtower, with no people or creatures.
Style/medium: Hand-inked Western fantasy adventure comic: expressive variable-weight brush contours, simplified believable anatomy, bold silhouette design, flat opaque colors, two or three hard-edged shadow shapes, sparse dry-brush texture, and selective line detail at faces and focal materials. Mature, handmade, and readable; no painterly blending, no glossy 3D.
Composition/framing: four equal square panels in a precise 2x2 grid; keep every subject complete and safely framed with generous internal padding; each panel must read independently while looking drawn by the same exact artist.
Lighting/mood: neutral diffuse daylight in every panel; calm, matter-of-fact presentation.
Color palette: natural local colors appropriate to each subject and environment; do not impose one shared atmospheric tint.
Constraints: consistent medium, brushwork, contour language, shape simplification, detail density, and material handling across all four panels; exactly the requested subjects and environments; the dragon has exactly four legs and two wings; no clipped bodies, limbs, wings, weapons, buildings, or tower; no fire, magic effects, dramatic sky, rim light, text, labels, logo, watermark, decorative frame, or outer border.

qa.notes: All four panels share the same variable-weight ink contours, opaque local color, hard-edged shadows, and handmade material language.

Lighting/mood: preserve neutral diffuse daylight and a matter-of-fact presentation.
